messages:
Nina K: Postmortem follow-up for last night's ETL lag + bad aggregation. Draft is here: https://redwood.internal/postmortem/177310. Need clear owners for remediation and a tracking cadence.

Owen L: I saw the aggregator thread spikes. Root cause appears to be file descriptor leak in shard merger (introduced in deploy 2026-03-20). I'm taking the hotfix and will revert the faulty close semantics. Target: tomorrow morning.

Priya S: I'll own regression tests for aggregation correctness. Plan: add a compact real-data vector test plus an invariants check (sum(counts) before/after). Will make the test CI-blocking after review. ETA: 72h.

Marcus D: Missing spans traced to the batching change in telemetry-client v2.4.1. I'm publishing a patch to restore header propagation and adding a span-coverage alert on traces_ingested < expected_traces.

Nina K: We should capture recurrence: similar incident on 2026-01-06 had aggregation skew but was chalked up to shard imbalance. I'll add a timeline section to the postmortem and link prior incidents.

Priya S: Quick checklist I'm adding to the PM draft:
- fail-fast CI guard for agg diffs
- deterministic vector daily run in nightlies
- add a merge-consistency audit to the QA playbook
I'll attach PR links once ready.

infra-bot: rollback initiated: release/etl-merger -> release/2026-03-20 (triggered by auto-detect: agg_mismatch_rate > 0.5%)

Owen L: Hotfix PR: #5051. Reverts commit f7d9c2. Also added FD leak detection in integration runner.

Marcus D: Patch published telemetry-client@2.4.2 with header fix. Added metric telemetry.headers/propagated_count. Alert: if headers/propagated_count drops > 10% vs baseline => P0.

Priya S: Example alert rule we added to prometheus:
```
- alert: AggOutputMismatch
  expr: agg_output_diff_total > 0
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Aggregator output mismatch detected"
```

Nina K: Action items summary (add task links):
- Hotfix & revert (Owen) - deploy by 2026-03-25 AM - ticket INC-8002
- Aggregation regression tests + CI guard (Priya) - 72h - ticket INC-8003
- Telemetry header patch + span alert (Marcus) - 24h - ticket INC-8004
- Postmortem timeline + recurrence analysis (Nina) - add prior incidents and proposed quarterly audit - ticket INC-8005
- Runbook update for ETL troubleshooting (oncall) - assign and update by next oncall rotation

alerts-bot: label applied: incident:observability, severity:high

Owen L: I'll schedule a follow-up sync in 48h and ping this thread with deploy status.

Priya S: I'll post PR link for agg-guard in this thread when ready.

Nina K: Thanks all. We'll meet Fri 11:00 PT to validate fixes and close action items. If anything blocks progress, @oncall or this thread. :white_check_mark:
